title: Task Space Motion Model
text: Model rigid body tree motion given task-space inputs, 3 inputs, 3 outputs, {Joint damping} sets Damping ratios [1; {Rigid body tree}, {End effector}, {Proportional gain}, {Derivative gain}, {Show external force input} displays FExt port, {Initial joint configuration} sets the initial joint positions, {Initial joint velocities} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Rigid body tree
params.values: Rigid body tree twoJointRigidBodyTree object (default) | RigidBodyTree object

params.name: Proportional gain
params.values: Proportional gain for PD Control 500*eye(6) (default) | 6-by-6 matrix

params.name: Derivative gain
params.values: Derivative gain for PD Control 100*eye(6) (default) | 6-by-6 matrix

params.name: Initial joint configuration
params.values: Initial joint positions 0 (default) | n -element vector | scalar

params.name: Initial joint velocities
params.values: Initial joint velocities 0 (default) | n -element vector | scalar

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
